lines.en: My short legs click with each step
I clatter along on bare joints
The ground clicks under me
My skull leans forward

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，从树干后绕出。
lines.en: I step over fallen leaves and come around the trunk.
I close in, swaying
My ribs whistle in the wind
I cross a patch of leaves
I limp along
I shuffle two steps your way
My shadow is small and thin
I work my way down a slope

lines.zh: 我站着不动，骨头也在晃
lines.en: I stand still, and my bones still sway
My jaw works slowly
I tip my skull and look around

lines.zh: 我在原地转半圈，骨头发响。
lines.en: I turn half around in place, bones creaking.
The wind sets my bones rattling
I look down at myself
One of my ribs has worked loose
I have no eyes and still I see
I wait for you to come nearer
I set my bones straight again
My empty sockets face you
You stand beside my bones
I tilt my skull your way

lines.zh: 你藏得再好，呼吸也瞒不过我。
lines.en: Hide as you like, your breathing betrays you.
I take one step closer
I raise my hand bones
My jaw parts a crack
You went behind that tree
I turn joint by joint
My bones click together
I lose a rib

lines.zh: 头骨被打歪，我抬手扶正。
lines.en: My skull is knocked crooked; I push it straight.
I back off two steps and hold
I crouch to gather my bones

lines.zh: 这一下把我的牙打松了
lines.en: That loosened a tooth
I push my hand bones back on
I sway twice before I keep from falling apart.
I am not coming apart yet
There is dirt in every joint
Stop knocking my bones
I do not even have a stomach

lines.zh: 你把食物举给我也没用
lines.en: Holding food up does nothing

lines.zh: 别晃了，我对吃的没兴趣。
lines.en: Stop waving it; food does not interest me.
There is no tongue in my mouth
It would fall right through me

lines.zh: 我连肚子都没有，收起来吧。
lines.en: I do not even have a belly. Put it away.
Bones are all I ask
I do not know your food
I turn my empty sockets on it

lines.zh: 这东西对骨头一点用都没有。
lines.en: This thing is utterly useless to bone.
You knock a few bones loose
I push my ribs back in
I stagger back
My bones rattle all at once
Hitting me is hitting a woodpile
I hold, but I am crooked
I keep that in my bone
I fit my bones back together
You stepped on my foot bone
I lunge and catch your sleeve
What is left of me for that
Bone against bone is nothing
I stopped thinking of it long ago
There are many of us in the earth
We cannot even laugh
You are asking the wrong thing
I shake my head, and it tips over
I set it back straight
Those in the earth no longer move
We do not speak, we cannot
I pick up a bone
This one is thinner than mine
I hold it against my hand
A bit short, but it will do
I wedge it between my ribs
It slips through the gap
So I pick it up again
This should not be shaped like this
I tap it against my ribs
That sound is not unpleasant
You stepped on my ground
I clatter over to you

lines.zh: 我的指骨一根根张了开来。
lines.en: My finger bones spread open one by one.

lines.zh: 活人的汗味顺着风飘来了。
lines.en: The sweat of the living drifts over on the wind.
I lift my jaw
My empty sockets hold you
You swung first. Do not blame me.
I square my shoulders
I am one step away

lines.zh: 你的脚踝已经在我的视线里。
lines.en: Your ankles are already in my sight.
My hand bones clench
I will see this through with you

lines.zh: 我前倾着身子，随时要扑。
lines.en: I lean forward, ready to lunge.
My jaw snaps shut

lines.zh: 你站在我够得到的地方
lines.en: You stand within my reach
I raise my arm slowly

lines.zh: 我不喊叫，只把下颌咬紧。
lines.en: I make no cry, only clench my jaw.
I follow you step by step
You dodged left just now
I drag my feet after you
My rattling gives me away
You go behind the tree, so do I

lines.zh: 我矮，可我够得着你的腿
lines.en: I am short, but your legs are in reach
I hold my hand bones out front
Back up further and you are cornered
I stay close to you
My jaw keeps working
I wait for you to turn away
Are my steps quiet
Leaves crackle under me
You will not shake me off
I know this stretch well
I shuffle half a step closer
You stop, and so do I
My joints keep clicking
Even limping I am not slow

lines.zh: 你把后背留给我，太迟了。
lines.en: You have turned your back to me. Too late.
I swing my hand bones at you
My teeth catch your leg
I throw my whole frame at you

lines.zh: 我的骨头刮过你的手臂
lines.en: My bones scrape your arm
I hit you and lose a piece of myself
I swing once more
You are knocked back a step

lines.zh: 我的指骨掐进你的衣服
lines.en: My finger bones dig into your clothes

lines.zh: 这一下带着我全部的劲
lines.en: That carried all the strength I have

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，手骨碰响了
lines.en: You block, and bone knocks bone
I lift my jaw and bite again

lines.zh: 我一击落空，退半步再站定。
lines.en: My swing misses; I step back and set my stance.
My shoulder bone drives into your chest

lines.zh: 我的骨头撞在你膝盖上
lines.en: My bone meets your knee
I kick with a foot bone
You guard your head and bare your side

lines.zh: 地下一堆骨头动了起来
lines.en: A heap of bones shifts in the ground
I climb up out of the soil
One hand bone comes up first
Bone joins bone
I straighten up, shorter than expected
My skull rights itself crookedly
I push the leaves aside
The sound in the soil comes first
I shake the dirt off my bones

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出，风一吹就打晃。
lines.en: I claw out of the dirt and sway at the first gust.
Dirt still clings to my bones
I slowly straighten my knee
A small skeleton joins the tree
My fingers move before the rest
The heat makes my bones crack
I land and my bones scatter
Water fills my hollow bones
The blast blows my frame apart

lines.zh: 箭从两根肋骨间穿了过去。
lines.en: The arrow slips between two of my ribs.

lines.zh: 咒光让我的骨头震起来
lines.en: Magic sets my bones humming
Hunger left me long ago
Lightning runs through my whole frame

lines.zh: 我散成一把骨头往下掉
lines.en: I scatter into a handful of bones
